narrative: The bill, on the bookwheel. A black-letter bill on the table. Title, house, and hour. No author's name. No sum. The bill, on the bookwheel. The lower line. The bill is not in a pocket. The hat is on the peg.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the title and kept the house.

entities.name: Hercules
entities.context: Shown on bill in Hercules, the first part
